title: G8 detection baseline (S3 eval)
description: Committed-ready detection baseline derived by resecta_data.eval.baseline from the Swift harness's offset-overlap join cells (CONTRACT.md File 1). Carries precision / recall / F1 / adversarial-suppression FP-rate per cell and aggregated per-family, per-doctype, per-demographic, and grand-total. Dev/eval artifact: not installed to the Swift Resources path. A low_confidence flag marks (but does not drop) slices whose positive support is below the small-sample floor -- the demographic-fairness guardrail.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

source_cells_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical-encoded input _cells.json payload. A hash of the build input (not a wall-clock), so the artifact stays determinism-safe.

per_family.description: Aggregate cell per category key (family). Keys are the PIICategory rawValues present in the join.

per_doctype.description: Aggregate cell per doctype. All five doctypes always present.

per_demographic.description: Aggregate cell per Census demographic bucket. All five buckets always present.

per_cell.description: Aggregate cell per raw <category>_<doctype>_<bucket> join key.

support_n.description: Positive GT support (TP + FN); the recall denominator.

detections_n.description: Surfaced detections of this kind (TP + FP); the precision denominator.

adversarial_suppression_fp_rate.description: GT-label-keyed decoy fire rate: adversarial_suppress_fired / adversarial_suppress_total.

low_confidence.description: True when support_n is below the small-sample floor (30). Advisory fairness flag; the slice is reported regardless.
